mapper.sql:
FROM activities a JOIN trips t ON t.id = a.trip_id AND t.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM places p WHERE p.id = a.place_ref_id) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM places p WHERE p.id = CASE WHEN BTRIM(a.place_id) ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN BTRIM(a.place_id)::uuid END)
AND a.place_review_dismissed_at IS NOT NULL AND a.place_review_dismissed_at IS NULL
AND (a.name ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR a.address ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR t.name ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%')

UPDATE activities SET place_review_dismissed_at = NULL, place_review_dismissed_by = NULL WHERE id = #{id,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} AND place_review_dismissed_at IS NOT NULL

UPDATE activities SET day_number = day_number + #{dayDelta}, end_day_number = CASE WHEN end_day_number IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE end_day_number + #{dayDelta} END, starting_point_date = CASE WHEN starting_point_date IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE starting_point_date + (#{dateDeltaDays} * INTERVAL '1 day') END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE trip_id = #{tripId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} AND day_number >= #{fromDay}

UPDATE activities SET day_number = CASE WHEN day_number = #{firstDay} THEN #{secondDay} ELSE #{firstDay} END, end_day_number = CASE WHEN end_day_number IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN day_number = #{firstDay} THEN end_day_number + (#{secondDay} - #{firstDay}) ELSE end_day_number + (#{firstDay} - #{secondDay}) END, starting_point_date = CASE WHEN starting_point_date IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN day_number = #{firstDay} THEN starting_point_date + ((#{secondDay} - #{firstDay}) * INTERVAL '1 day') ELSE starting_point_date + ((#{firstDay} - #{secondDay}) * INTERVAL '1 day') END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE trip_id = #{tripId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} AND day_number IN (#{firstDay}, #{secondDay})
